An '''Arask beetle''' was a type of beetle, that could be found on the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] [[Tilnes]].

{{Creature-stub}}

==Biology==
Arask beetles were parasitic. They were about ten centimeters long and had silvery-black eye-stalks.
